thread:
Ravi: Quick check-in: before we roll the style pass, can we agree on 3 concrete naming rules for docs examples? Trying to avoid bikeshed during reviews.

Clara: Proposal: 1) Use `model` for public-facing API params, 2) Use `checkpoint` only in engineering deep dives, 3) Example flags: `--model` (short) in CLI snippets.

Nate: +1. Also add: prefer lower_snake_case in JSON/examples, camelCase only if it mirrors SDK method names exactly.

Ravi: OK that gives reviewers clear guidance. Can someone add these to the PR checklist and the top of style-guide.md?

Clara: I'll update style-guide.md with a short "Naming rules" section and a one-line rationale for each.

Nate: I'll add a checklist entry to .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md: "Naming: model vs checkpoint, JSON case, CLI flags".

docs-bot: Reminder: tag PRs with `#docs` and `#style`. If touching >10 pages, open a tracking ticket.

Ravi: Thanks. If anyone sees ambiguous cases (e.g., `artifact` vs `model`), flag in PR and we'll decide with examples rather than long threads.

Clara: Will do. Planning to push the style doc tweak in ~1h and open the PR template change after that.
